one_line: Open on finished hero covers with a "what if" line, then real reactions and a one-line ordering recap.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 two books stand on artificial grass, a girl as hero on each cover. Subtitle "מה אם הייתי אומרת". Voiceover (transcript): "שאת יכולה להפוך את הילדים שלך לגיבורים". 0:02 cut to a mother and two girls on a sofa.
q1_hook.why: A "what if" question opens a gap, can your child be the hero of the bedtime book, answered by real clips from 0:02 (H5, H1). The finished covers are the first frame (S1). Voice and subtitle start together (H6); value is clear by 5 s (H2). No person until 0:02 (H4 partly).

beats.what: Two hero-cover books on artificial grass; "מה אם הייתי אומרת"
beats.why: The finished product first, with a question

beats.what: A mother and two girls read on a sofa; "שאת יכולה להפוך את הילדים שלך לגיבורים"
beats.why: The promise, with a real family

beats.what: A girl opens the book, gasps and laughs; first grade, "הדרך הכי טובה להכין אותה"
beats.why: A burst of joy and the first reason

beats.what: Mother and girl on a pink bed; a girl alone turns pages; "זה מדהים כמה שזה דומה לה"
beats.why: The likeness claim over a happy reader

beats.what: Top-down page flip on grass, the girl as hero; "בוסט של ביטחון עצמי"
beats.why: Shows the pages and a second reason

beats.what: A second mother and a girl on a bed; "שיפור משמעותי בחוויה שלה בגן"; both point at us
beats.why: A new voice and a new reason

beats.what: A girl holds up her cover; pages flip: a wizard, a cape, a cat; "העלאת תחושת הביטחון"
Full-screen phone recording of the MeBook.ai site; "תיכנסו לאתר ותוך כמה דקות"
Two hero covers on grey marble; "כי מה יותר טוב מזה... היא הם עצמם?"
beats.why: A closing line that restates the promise

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption giveaway: follow two accounts, share the Reel in a story, tag at least 2 friends in comments, draw on 18.12.25. The video itself ends on a rhetorical question and does not mention the giveaway.
q2_flow.why: A promise in the first line, then three parent clips with different reasons, first grade, a new gan, confidence, keep the middle varied (R3, K6, S6). Clips change every 2 to 4 s (E2). The closing question answers itself (R4), and the giveaway asks live only in the caption (C2).

q3_cta.what: Spoken (transcript) and subtitled 0:36 to 0:41: "תיכנסו לאתר ותוך כמה דקות גם לכם יהיה ספר משלכם". The giveaway is not in the video. Caption: follow two accounts, share to a story, tag 2 friends, draw date.
q3_cta.why: The video asks one thing after the benefits, go to the site, said and written over a readable site recording (C6). The caption asks for follow, share and tag two friends to win, actions whose goal is the count (C2, R6), and three steps are more than one ask (C1).

q4_shown.what: Two hero-cover books on grass (0:00); mothers and girls reading on sofas and beds (0:02 to 0:30); top-down page flips with the girl as hero (0:18, 0:31); a girl holding her cover (0:30, 0:36); a full-width phone recording of mebook.ai (0:37 to 0:41). No price.
q4_shown.why: Real mother and child reactions give first-hand vouching (S6, K8). A girl holds her cover beside her face at 0:30 and 0:36, about 1 s each, short of the 2 s steadiness (S2). The site recording shows the range of stories, not upload or name (S8 not met). Children's faces show (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 15 shots in 44 s, about 2.9 s each, straight cuts; handheld family clips alternate with static top-down page flips on grass. Subtitles on black highlight boxes change about every second. Ends on two covers on marble with a question.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 2 to 4 s and alternating clip types fit the moderate pace (E2, R3). Highlight-box subtitles that change every second work muted (E4, T2). It ends on a closing line over the covers (E8), though 44 s is long for one promise (R2).

q6_topic.what: Parents say a personalised book made their daughters heroes, easing the move to first grade and a new gan, with a giveaway of two books. Serves parents facing a transition.
q6_topic.why: Transitions, first grade and a new gan, are real parent concerns and buying moments (K6, K7). Joy on the girls' faces gives a positive peak (K1, K8). "Significant improvement in the gan" is a parent's strong, unchecked claim for a book (K4).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone clips on sofas and pink beds at home, medium and close; static top-down page flips on artificial grass; a girl holding her cover to the lens; a full-screen phone recording; two covers top-down on grey marble. Bright indoor light.
q7_filmed.why: Home clips with natural laughter read as real families (H8, F7), and top-down page flips put a hand turning pages in the viewer's view (F5, F4). Page text is small, but the cartoon faces are clear. Subtitles at 70 to 77% of frame height sit in the bottom 35% (F2).

q8_text.on_screen: Large white subtitles with black highlight boxes on key words, one to two lines, centred at about 70 to 77% of the frame height, changing about every second: "מה אם הייתי אומרת" (0:00), "לגיבורים בספרים" (0:03), "וזה מדהים כמה שזה דומה לה" (0:12), "שיפור משמעותי בחוויה שלה בגן" (0:27), "תיכנסו לאתר ותוך" (0:36), "עצמם?" (0:43). No headline card; no giveaway text.
q8_text.caption: "✨הגרלה✨הגרלה✨הגרלה✨". About 120 words: the prize (a book of the winner's choice), a three-step way to enter (follow two accounts, share to a story, tag 2 friends), a draw date and time. No hashtags, no partnership words.
q8_text.why: Boxed key words keep contrast over busy pictures (T5) and the subtitles work muted (T1), but they sit in the bottom 35% and two text layers overlap at 0:37 (T4, T2). The caption opens with a clear giveaway hook, no keywords or hashtags (T7), and no partnership words (T8).

weak_points: Giveaway rules only in the caption and built on share and tag (C2); the video never mentions the giveaway; two text layers overlap at 0:37; subtitles in the bottom 35%; children's names in speech and on covers.
lumebook_takeaway: Film top-down page flips on a plain surface, a screen recording of the order, and one spoken and written CTA; hands only.
not_verified: Which woman is the creator; whether the voices are the mothers' own; music (cannot hear); the book price; whether the giveaway is paid (label 0, coauthor mebook.ai). Children's names are spoken and printed on covers and were not copied. Correction to src/coded: the website recording runs 0:37 to 0:41 with a double text layer at 0:37; the closing question sits at 0:42 to 0:44; the caption asks for three actions.
